compositions.threat: One melee pursuer pressures players who stop to mine.
compositions.counterplay: Keep a clear retreat lane and use corners to break pursuit.

compositions.threat: Two melee pursuers make a narrow dead end costly to hold.
compositions.counterplay: Retreat through a wider junction and avoid letting both close together.

compositions.threat: A ranged attacker forces players to break line of sight while mining.
compositions.counterplay: Use pillars and corners to block shots, then close the distance.

compositions.threat: A sun-immune patroller lingers near the entrance without ever retreating to shade.
compositions.counterplay: Treat it like any melee pursuer; it has no special resistance underground.

compositions.threat: A quicker armored melee fighter contests space alongside a pursuer.
compositions.counterplay: Focus one target, kite around a junction, and avoid being cornered.

compositions.threat: Two fast melee attackers can close from different angles.
compositions.counterplay: Use the room perimeter, keep moving, and regroup before re-engaging.

compositions.threat: A small swarm of climbers and crawlers presses from multiple directions.
compositions.counterplay: Back into a corridor so only one can reach you at a time.

compositions.threat: A crossbow-wielding raider keeps its distance and punishes a straight approach.
compositions.counterplay: Close the gap diagonally behind cover; its reload window is the opening.

compositions.threat: An armored, faster attacker and two pursuers divide attention in a large chamber.
compositions.counterplay: Coordinate target focus, keep the exit visible, and use distance to reset the fight.

compositions.threat: A mobile swarm of fast armored attackers replaces a stationary damage race.
compositions.counterplay: Fight from open space, call focus targets, and peel attackers off teammates.

compositions.threat: Armored skeletal patrol that shrugs off weak gear in the deepest chamber.
compositions.counterplay: Bring upgraded gear from earlier depths before engaging; retreat to a chokepoint.

compositions.threat: A fire-ranged attacker punishes players who stand still in the open.
compositions.counterplay: Use pillars and corners to block fireballs, then close the distance quickly.

compositions.threat: A tight patrol from the deepest tier presses together.
compositions.counterplay: Separate them with a corner before any can land a hit; they hit hard at this depth.

compositions.threat: A larger patrol floods a chamber from several angles at once.
compositions.counterplay: Retreat to a corridor so only one can close at a time; do not stand and trade.

compositions.threat: Bouncing, fire-touched attackers close distance unpredictably.
compositions.counterplay: Keep moving and strike on the landing, not the bounce; avoid melee while they're airborne.

compositions.threat: A single, heavily armored elite hits far harder than anything found above this depth.
compositions.counterplay: Bring the best gear the mine has offered so far; fight at a chokepoint, not in the open.

compositions.threat: An aggressive charger closes distance in a straight, unpredictable rush.
compositions.counterplay: Sidestep the charge rather than block it head-on, then punish the recovery.
